ticket.subject: Cannot upload files over 10 MB
ticket.body_text:
Hi there!

I look after our account at Tidewell Logistics. Uploading PDF files larger than about 10 MB fails at 99% with 'upload error'.

Smaller files upload fine, so we split the large ones for now. Your docs say the limit is 50 MB on our plan.

A reply in the next few days would be great. Is there a fix planned?

Thanks so much!
Yara

label_notes: clean bug (bug-upload-large): impaired with a workaround is P3; urgency medium: action needed this week.
